DOGE.gloss: formerly the chief magistrate in the republics of Venice and Genoa
DOGE.definition: Formerly the chief magistrate in the republics of Venice and Genoa.

GOD.gloss: any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect…
GOD.definition: Any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect of life or who is the personification of a force.

DOG.gloss: a member of the genus Canis that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times
DOG.definition: A member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds.

DIE.gloss: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to…
DIE.definition: Pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life.

EGG.gloss: animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and…
EGG.definition: Animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes; especially the thin-shelled reproductive body laid by e.g. female birds.

DIG.gloss: turn up, loosen, or remove earth
DIG.definition: Turn up, loosen, or remove earth.

EGO.gloss: an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others
EGO.definition: An inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others.

GIG.definition: Long and light rowing boat; especially for racing.

DOE.gloss: mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'
DOE.definition: Mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'.
